---
title: "NHS Scotland Waiting Times"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- Shared helpers -------------------------------------------------------
fmtMonth   = d => d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })
fmtQuarter = d => `${d.getFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.getMonth() / 3) + 1}`
fmtNum     = n => n == null ? "—" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-GB")
uniqSorted = arr => Array.from(new Set(arr)).sort()
boardDefault = bs => bs.includes("Scotland") ? "Scotland" : bs[0]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- Waiting Profile data -------------------------------------------------
wpData    = FileAttachment("data/waiting_profile.json").json()
wpBoards  = uniqSorted(wpData.map(d => d.hb))
wpPtypes  = uniqSorted(wpData.map(d => d.ptype))
wpSpecs   = ["All", ...uniqSorted(wpData.filter(d => d.spec !== "All").map(d => d.spec))]

wpFiltered = wpData
  .filter(d => d.hb === wpHb && d.ptype === wpPtype && d.spec === wpSpec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date), total: d.w1 + d.w2 + d.w3 + d.w4 }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

wpLatest = wpFiltered.length ? wpFiltered[wpFiltered.length - 1] : null

bandOrder = ["0–26 weeks", "26–52 weeks", "52–78 weeks", "Over 78 weeks"]
bands = wpFiltered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, band: "0–26 weeks",    value: d.w1 },
  { date: d.date, band: "26–52 weeks",   value: d.w2 },
  { date: d.date, band: "52–78 weeks",   value: d.w3 },
  { date: d.date, band: "Over 78 weeks", value: d.w4 }
])
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- Balance data ---------------------------------------------------------
balData   = FileAttachment("data/balance.json").json()
balBoards = uniqSorted(balData.map(d => d.hb))
balPtypes = uniqSorted(balData.map(d => d.ptype))
balSpecs  = ["All", ...uniqSorted(balData.filter(d => d.spec !== "All").map(d => d.spec))]

balFiltered = balData
  .filter(d => d.hb === balHb && d.ptype === balPtype && d.spec === balSpec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

balLatest = balFiltered.length ? balFiltered[balFiltered.length - 1] : null

addRem = balFiltered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, series: "Additions", value: d.add },
  { date: d.date, series: "Removals", value: d.rem }
])

reasonOrder = ["Attended", "Referred", "Transferred", "No Treatment", "Other"]
reasons = balFiltered.flatMap(d => {
  const parts = { Attended: d.attended, Referred: d.referred, Transferred: d.transferred, "No Treatment": d.notreat, Other: d.other }
  const sum = reasonOrder.reduce((a, r) => a + (parts[r] || 0), 0)
  return reasonOrder.map(r => ({ date: d.date, reason: r, pct: sum ? (parts[r] || 0) / sum * 100 : 0 }))
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- 12-week Target data --------------------------------------------------
t12Data   = FileAttachment("data/target12.json").json()
t12Boards = uniqSorted(t12Data.map(d => d.hb))
t12Ptypes = uniqSorted(t12Data.map(d => d.ptype))
t12Specs  = ["All", ...uniqSorted(t12Data.filter(d => d.spec !== "All").map(d => d.spec))]

t12Filtered = t12Data
  .filter(d => d.hb === t12Hb && d.ptype === t12Ptype && d.spec === t12Spec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

t12Latest = t12Filtered.length ? t12Filtered[t12Filtered.length - 1] : null
t12Pct = t12Latest && t12Latest.seen ? t12Latest.within12 / t12Latest.seen * 100 : null
t12Theme = t12Pct == null ? "primary" : t12Pct >= 95 ? "success" : t12Pct >= 80 ? "warning" : "danger"

treatedSeries = ["Within 12 weeks", "Over 12 weeks"]
treatedLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, series: "Within 12 weeks", value: d.within12 },
  { date: d.date, series: "Over 12 weeks", value: d.over12 }
])
pctLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => {
  const tot = d.seen || 0
  return [
    { date: d.date, series: "Within 12 weeks", pct: tot ? d.within12 / tot * 100 : 0 },
    { date: d.date, series: "Over 12 weeks", pct: tot ? d.over12 / tot * 100 : 0 }
  ]
})
waitLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, metric: "Median", value: d.median },
  { date: d.date, metric: "90th percentile", value: d.p90 }
])
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- Diagnostic Waits data ------------------------------------------------
diagData   = FileAttachment("data/diagnostics.json").json()
diagGroups = ["0 to 4 weeks", "4 to 8 weeks", "8 to 18 weeks", "4 to 12 months", "Over 1 year", "Other"]
diagBoards = uniqSorted(diagData.map(d => d.hb))
diagTypes  = uniqSorted(diagData.map(d => d.type))
diagDescs  = uniqSorted(diagData.filter(d => d.type === diagType).map(d => d.desc))

diagFiltered = diagData
  .filter(d => d.hb === diagHb && d.type === diagType && d.desc === diagDesc)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))

diagByMonth = Array.from(d3.group(diagFiltered, d => +d.date), ([t, rows]) => {
  const date = new Date(t)
  const m = {}; diagGroups.forEach(g => m[g] = 0)
  let total = 0; rows.forEach(r => { m[r.grp] = (m[r.grp] || 0) + r.n; total += r.n })
  return { date, total, ...m }
}).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

diagLatest = diagByMonth.length ? diagByMonth[diagByMonth.length - 1] : null
```

# Waiting Profile {orientation="rows"}

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof wpHb = Inputs.select(wpBoards, { label: "Health Board", value: boardDefault(wpBoards) })
viewof wpPtype = Inputs.select(wpPtypes, { label: "Patient Type" })
viewof wpSpec = Inputs.select(wpSpecs, { label: "Specialty", value: "All" })
```

## Column

### Row {height="160px"}

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card primary">
    <div class="stat-label">Total on Waiting List</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${wpLatest ? fmtNum(wpLatest.total) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${wpLatest ? fmtMonth(wpLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card danger">
    <div class="stat-label">Waiting Over 52 Weeks</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${wpLatest ? fmtNum(wpLatest.w3 + wpLatest.w4) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${wpLatest ? fmtMonth(wpLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Total Number of Patients on Waiting List
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Number of patients", tickFormat: "~s" },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(wpFiltered, { x: "date", y: "total", fill: "#0078D4", fillOpacity: 0.12 }),
    Plot.lineY(wpFiltered, { x: "date", y: "total", stroke: "#0078D4", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(wpFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date", y: "total",
      title: d => `${fmtMonth(d.date)}\n${fmtNum(d.total)} patients`
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Breakdown of Patient Waiting Times
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Patients waiting", tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: bandOrder, range: ["#90CAF9", "#42A5F5", "#1976D2", "#0D47A1"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(bands, { x: "date", y: "value", fill: "band", order: bandOrder }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(wpFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: d => d.w1 + d.w2 + d.w3 + d.w4,
      title: d => [
        fmtMonth(d.date),
        `0–26 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.w1)}`,
        `26–52 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.w2)}`,
        `52–78 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.w3)}`,
        `Over 78 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.w4)}`,
        `Total: ${fmtNum(d.w1 + d.w2 + d.w3 + d.w4)}`
      ].join("\n")
    }))
  ]
})
```

# Balance {orientation="rows"}

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof balHb = Inputs.select(balBoards, { label: "Health Board", value: boardDefault(balBoards) })
viewof balPtype = Inputs.select(balPtypes, { label: "Patient Type" })
viewof balSpec = Inputs.select(balSpecs, { label: "Specialty", value: "All" })
```

## Column

### Row {height="160px"}

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card primary">
    <div class="stat-label">Additions</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${balLatest ? fmtNum(balLatest.add) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${balLatest ? fmtQuarter(balLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card primary">
    <div class="stat-label">Removals</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${balLatest ? fmtNum(balLatest.rem) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${balLatest ? fmtQuarter(balLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card ${balLatest && balLatest.bal > 0 ? "danger" : "success"}">
    <div class="stat-label">Net Change</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${balLatest ? fmtNum(balLatest.bal) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${balLatest ? fmtQuarter(balLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Waiting List Additions and Removals
Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Number of Patients", tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: ["Additions", "Removals"], range: ["#FF7043", "#00897B"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(addRem, { x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(balFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: d => Math.max(d.add, d.rem),
      title: d => `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nAdditions: ${fmtNum(d.add)}\nRemovals: ${fmtNum(d.rem)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Net Change in Waiting List Size
Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Net Change in Number of Patients", tickFormat: "~s" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(balFiltered, {
      x: "date", y: "bal", interval: "3 months",
      fill: d => d.bal >= 0 ? "#DC2626" : "#059669"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(balFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date", y: "bal",
      title: d => `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nNet change: ${fmtNum(d.bal)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Reasons for Removal from Waiting List
Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Percentage of Removals", domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: reasonOrder, range: ["#0078D4", "#42A5F5", "#90CAF9", "#1976D2", "#0D47A1"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(reasons, { x: "date", y: "pct", fill: "reason", order: reasonOrder }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(balFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: () => 100,
      title: d => {
        const parts = { Attended: d.attended, Referred: d.referred, Transferred: d.transferred, "No Treatment": d.notreat, Other: d.other }
        const sum = reasonOrder.reduce((a, r) => a + (parts[r] || 0), 0)
        return [fmtQuarter(d.date), ...reasonOrder.map(r => `${r}: ${sum ? ((parts[r] || 0) / sum * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%`)].join("\n")
      }
    }))
  ]
})
```

# 12-Week Target {orientation="rows"}

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof t12Hb = Inputs.select(t12Boards, { label: "Health Board", value: boardDefault(t12Boards) })
viewof t12Ptype = Inputs.select(t12Ptypes, { label: "Patient Type" })
viewof t12Spec = Inputs.select(t12Specs, { label: "Specialty", value: "All" })
```

## Column

### Row {height="160px"}

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card ${t12Theme}">
    <div class="stat-label">Seen Within 12 Weeks</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${t12Pct == null ? "—" : t12Pct.toFixed(1) + "%"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${t12Latest ? fmtQuarter(t12Latest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card danger">
    <div class="stat-label">Waiting Over 12 Weeks</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${t12Latest ? fmtNum(t12Latest.over12) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${t12Latest ? fmtQuarter(t12Latest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Number of Patients Treated by Wait Time
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: null, tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: treatedSeries, range: ["#059669", "#DC2626"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(treatedLong, { x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(t12Filtered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: d => Math.max(d.within12, d.over12),
      title: d => `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nWithin 12 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.within12)}\nOver 12 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.over12)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Cumulative Number of Patients Treated
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: null, tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: treatedSeries, range: ["#059669", "#DC2626"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(treatedLong, { x: "date", y: "value", fill: "series", order: treatedSeries }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(t12Filtered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: d => d.within12 + d.over12,
      title: d => `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nWithin 12 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.within12)}\nOver 12 weeks: ${fmtNum(d.over12)}\nTotal: ${fmtNum(d.seen)}`
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Percentage of Patients Treated by Treatment Wait Time
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: null, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: treatedSeries, range: ["#059669", "#DC2626"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(pctLong, { x: "date", y: "pct", fill: "series", order: treatedSeries }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(t12Filtered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: () => 100,
      title: d => {
        const tot = d.seen || 0
        return `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nWithin 12 weeks: ${tot ? (d.within12 / tot * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%\nOver 12 weeks: ${tot ? (d.over12 / tot * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%`
      }
    }))
  ]
})
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Breakdown of Wait Times
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Days Waited", tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: ["Median", "90th percentile"], range: ["#0078D4", "#FF6B6B"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(waitLong, { x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "metric", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(t12Filtered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: d => Math.max(d.median || 0, d.p90 || 0),
      title: d => `${fmtQuarter(d.date)}\nMedian: ${fmtNum(d.median)} days\n90th percentile: ${fmtNum(d.p90)} days`
    }))
  ]
})
```

# Diagnostic Waits {orientation="rows"}

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof diagHb = Inputs.select(diagBoards, { label: "Health Board", value: boardDefault(diagBoards) })
viewof diagType = Inputs.select(diagTypes, { label: "Diagnostic Test Type" })
viewof diagDesc = Inputs.select(diagDescs, { label: "Diagnostic Test Description" })
```

## Column

### Row {height="160px"}

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card primary" style="max-width: 320px">
    <div class="stat-label">Total Waiting</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${diagLatest ? fmtNum(diagLatest.total) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${diagLatest ? fmtMonth(diagLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

### Row


```{ojs}
//| title: Diagnostic Waiting Patients Over Time
Plot.plot({
  height: 560,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Number of Patients Waiting", tickFormat: "~s" },
  color: {
    legend: true,
    domain: diagGroups,
    range: ["#90CAF9", "#42A5F5", "#1976D2", "#0D47A1", "#1A237E", "#9E9E9E"]
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(diagFiltered, { x: "date", y: "n", z: "grp", fill: "grp", order: diagGroups }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(diagByMonth, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: "total",
      title: d => [
        fmtMonth(d.date),
        ...diagGroups.filter(g => d[g] > 0).map(g => `${g}: ${fmtNum(d[g])}`),
        `Total: ${fmtNum(d.total)}`
      ].join("\n")
    }))
  ]
})
```
